topic: Wrist pain after a fall on an outstretched hand

slides.headline: Fell on your hand? Check the wrist
slides.sub: Most wrist sprains settle, but some injuries need a closer look.

slides.title: A common way to get hurt
slides.body: Slipping on a wet deck, falling off a bike or a scooter, or tripping at the beach: we instinctively put a hand out. That can strain ligaments or injure a bone in the wrist.

slides.title: First few days
slides.body: Protect it, keep it raised and use a cold pack for short periods. Remove rings early in case of swelling. Keep your fingers, elbow and shoulder moving gently.

slides.title: Get it checked if bone is possible
slides.body: Tenderness in the hollow at the base of the thumb, swelling, a change in shape or trouble gripping can point to a fracture. These often need an X-ray through your GP or emergency department.

slides.title: Rebuilding movement and grip
slides.body: Once serious injury is ruled out, gentle range exercises, then grip and weight-bearing work, help most wrists recover. Pushing up from a chair is a useful later test.

slides.title: If it's slow to settle
slides.body: Some wrist injuries don't show much at first. If pain in the wrist hasn't eased after a week or two, an assessment is a sensible next step.

slides.headline: Wrist still sore after a fall?
slides.body: Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios assess your wrist, arrange next steps with your GP if needed, and guide your rehab. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Fell on an outstretched hand and your wrist is still sore?

Putting a hand out when you fall is instinctive. Summer slips on wet decks, bike and scooter spills all do it. Many cases are sprains that settle, but some involve a small bone at the base of the thumb that can be easy to miss.

Tenderness in the hollow at the base of the thumb, swelling, a change in shape or trouble gripping are worth getting checked, often with an X-ray through your GP or emergency department. Once that's ruled out, rehab rebuilds movement and grip.

story.headline: Hurt your wrist in a fall?
story.body: Tender at the base of the thumb or hard to grip? Get it checked. Some wrist injuries are easy to miss.
